decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the reports, specifications and drawings detailed 730/PL2/110 rev C; 730/PL2/111 rev H; 730/PL2/112 rev F; Section A-A 730/PL2/113 rev D; 730/PL2/114 rev F and 730/PL2/116 rev E;  730/PL2/117 Rev F.
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme.

Condition : 2 - Within 2 months of the date of this planning permission, the rear access door, first floor ledges and staircase must be removed and the rear opening filled in with brickwork and surfaces made good to match existing.
Reason: To ensure an independent residential use is not established and that there would be no loss of privacy or security to nearby properties in line with policy LP2.
Condition : 3 - Details of external fixed shutters shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority within one month of the date of this planning permission and shall be installed within two months of the approval of details.  The shutters must be retained in accordance with the approved details unless written approval is obtained from the Council.
Reason: To protect neighbouring properties from light pollution in line with policy LP2.
Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby approved shall be retained as a single storey building at all times and no mezzanine or upper floor level be reinstated or created within the building without the prior approval of the Council. 
Reason: To prevent a perceived sense of overlooking to properties in St Anns Hill and to prevent the use of the space as a residential unit in accordance with policy LP2.
Condition : 5 - The outbuilding hereby approved shall be used only for incidental residential purposes in conjunction with and ancillary to the use of the main property as a dwelling in accordance with policy LP2 and LP14 of the Local Plan.
Reason: To prevent the introduction of an independent residential or commercial rental use without the prior approval of the Council. 
Condition : 6 - INFORMATIVE: In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. The Council has made available detailed advice in the form of its statutory policies in the Local Plan (2023) as well as offering a full pre-application advice service, in order to ensure that the applicant has been given every opportunity to submit an application which is likely to be considered favourably. In addition, where appropriate, further guidance was offered to the applicant during the processing of the application.
description: Retention of outbuilding and excavation of sunken patio area in rear garden (Revised documents).
